title: Samsung Plant Disease Detection Model
description: Developed a CNN-based deep learning model to classify 10+ plant disease categories from leaf images. Trained and evaluated multiple architectures on 1000+ images with preprocessing and augmentation to improve robustness. Designed an inference pipeline for mobile deployment.

title: Online Payment Fraud Detection System
description: Built machine learning models using Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and XGBoost to detect fraudulent financial transactions. Performed feature engineering and hyperparameter tuning, achieving high classification accuracy. Deployed via a Streamlit app for real-time prediction.

title: ScoopCast – Movie Discovery Platform
description: Developed a responsive movie discovery platform integrating TMDB API to fetch and display 1000+ movies and TV shows. Implemented search, filtering, and dynamic rendering with asynchronous API handling.

title: Productivity Dashboard Website
description: Built a multi-feature productivity dashboard integrating To-Do List, Daily Planner, Pomodoro Timer, and motivation module. Included real-time date, weather, and location data with a responsive UI for cross-device usability.
